ALERT: GraphQL Error Rate Spike on api-gateway-prod-01

Severity: High
Timestamp: 2026-05-10T09:45:00Z
Source: Datadog APM

The API gateway instance api-gateway-prod-01 is reporting a GraphQL error rate of 8.4% over the last 5 minutes, exceeding the 5% threshold. The application is api-gateway running in the production environment in the us-east-1 AWS region. The service tier is tier-1. Recent deployment was performed 35 minutes ago (v2.14.1). Errors are concentrated on the orders query resolver and the userProfile mutation. Upstream service latency has increased to p99=1820ms. The protocol is graphql and the alert source is datadog. Host type is api-gateway.
